'''Siva Smail''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who had a set of [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] that were adorned with intricate patterns that were [[Color/Legends|red]] and yellow in color. Smail served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and sometime after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], she traveled to the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on the world [[Tazan]], so that she could give a presentation on the subject of a new planned maintenance system for [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]]. While Smail prepared for her presentation inside the base's presentation room, she encountered a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents that had [[Mission to Tazan|infiltrated]] the facility. The agents sought to recover a set of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] communication protocols and Smail pretended to help them, by claiming that she would lead them to someone that knew about the protocols. However, she then covertly attempted to alert the base's staff that the facility's security had been breached.
